command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
# R needs a writable TMPDIR/HOME or it dies with "cannot create R_TempDir"
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp

cat > gen.R <<'RSCRIPT'
set.seed(42)
G <- 2000; N <- 4                      # genes; samples per group
nDE <- 200; lfc <- 2                   # planted differential genes, |log2FC|
base <- rnbinom(G, mu = 200, size = 5) + 10
grp  <- factor(rep(c("ctrl","trt"), each = N))
de   <- sort(sample(G, nDE))
dir  <- rep(c(1,-1), length.out = nDE)  # half up, half down
mu   <- matrix(rep(base, 2*N), nrow = G)
mu[cbind(de, rep(N+1, nDE))] -> ignore
for (j in (N+1):(2*N)) mu[de, j] <- base[de] * 2^(lfc*dir)
counts <- matrix(rnbinom(G*2*N, mu = as.vector(mu), size = 8), nrow = G,
                 dimnames = list(paste0("g", seq_len(G)), paste0("s", seq_len(2*N))))
write.table(counts, "counts.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE)
write.table(data.frame(gene=paste0("g", de), dir=dir), "truth.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
cat("planted", nDE, "of", G, "genes at |log2FC| =", lfc, "\n")

suppressMessages(library(DESeq2))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts, data.frame(grp), ~ grp)
res <- results(DESeq(dds, quiet=TRUE))
out <- data.frame(gene=rownames(res), lfc=res$log2FoldChange, padj=res$padj)
write.table(out, "res_deseq2.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
sig <- subset(out, !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05)
cat("DESeq2 significant:", nrow(sig), " recovered planted:",
    sum(paste0("g", de) %in% sig$gene), "of", nDE, "\n")
RSCRIPT
Rscript gen.R
